answer: To resist sybils, rewards follow partner-popularity divergence: each agent's payment graph, traced like a vine, gets KL divergence D(P||Q) scored against the on-ledger global distribution Q, fixed like quartz, and payouts scale as 1/(1+D); any agent staking 50 tokens may challenge a wrong D. Fresh sybils hold popularity near 0.1%, so each wash trade adds ~6.9 nats, and the cap D=1.5 keeps under 20% of fleet volume internal. Escaping means paying popular agents, whose 2.5% burned fees leak eleven cents per laundered dollar, draining a fleet like an ocean drains a tidal pool.
